doubts.claim_under_doubt: Reading parent.runtime and parent.codexIntegrationMode directly from the live SdkSessionsStore across multiple await points is safe.
doubts.disproof_attempt: A concurrent store.patch() on the same task (e.g. the user relaunching the parent in another tab) can mutate those fields mid-request, desyncing the preflight check from the command-building branch — a TOCTOU race.
doubts.what_would_resolve_it: Fixed: snapshotted both fields into local consts (parentRuntime, parentCodexIntegrationMode) immediately after store.get(), before any await; used only the locals thereafter. Regression test added in fork.codextender.test.ts.

doubts.claim_under_doubt: injectEnvPrefix's fallback to prepending the env-var block when the cd-prefix doesn't match cwd is a safe defensive default.
doubts.disproof_attempt: It silently produces a command with two cd-prefixes / an ambiguous working directory (e.g. a custom action built from project.path instead of task.cwd) instead of failing loudly, which can launch in the wrong directory undetected.
doubts.what_would_resolve_it: Fixed: added CodextenderCwdMismatchError, thrown instead of silently falling through; runtime-chokepoint.ts catches it and returns a codextender_cwd_mismatch 500. Regression tests added in launcher-codextender.test.ts and runtime-chokepoint.codextender.test.ts.

doubts.claim_under_doubt: The qCmd-style escaping helper's quoting model matches cmd.exe's own tokenizer for all inputs.
doubts.disproof_attempt: It does not exactly match cmd.exe's tokenizer for all inputs, though no current caller passes attacker-controlled input through that path, so it is not currently exploitable.
doubts.what_would_resolve_it: Left unfixed by decision — 'don't validate scenarios that can't happen'. This recorded finding stands as the warning for any future extension of this code.

verification: Both HIGH findings fixed and verified with dedicated regression tests plus a full server test-suite re-run.
